Ryan L: Heads up — need to roll forward hotfix to prod v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2, deploy bot failing MFA prompt.
Deploy Bot: Deploy blocked: MFA challenge for user ryanl failed (error code MFA_TIMEOUT). See /deploy logs: https://internal.deploy/logs/1735551234
Ryan L: I am on my phone, MFA app not sending push.
Maria K: Can someone with deploy role press the button? I'm not IAM admin.
Jess H: I'm in a meeting, but can do if we get a short JIT grant. What's the minimum scope?
Security Bot: Policy: temporary_deployer role allowed for up to 15m with two approvers. Audit log will record.
Sam P: I can approve. @Maria K can you be second? or @sre-oncall?
Maria K: I can approve. Grant for ryanl or should Sam press?
Ryan L: Prefer Sam press — I'm blocked by MFA.
sre-oncall: I can grant JIT to Sam for 10m. Creating request...
sre-oncall: /grant-jit user=SamP role=deployer duration=600 reason="prod rollforward hotfix"
Deploy Bot: JIT grant issued to SamP, expires in 600s. Audit: GIST12345
Sam P: On it, starting deploy.
Deploy Bot: Starting deploy to prod: v2.3.2 -> rolling updates on 6 nodes. Logs: https://internal.deploy/logs/run/1735551234
Deploy Bot: Deploy succeeded. Release notes updated: https://internal.release/notes/2.3.2
Ryan L: :relieved: thanks all. Follow-up: open a runbook item for MFA push flakiness.
Maria K: Added issue #1234 to backlog.
Security Bot: Reminder: rotate deployer sessions weekly.
Jess H: noted.
